learning_outcomes.text: Student has knowledge in the field of various materials used in industrial practice.

Student has knowledge regarding correct usage of literature. possesses basic knowledge necessary to understand the ex-technical conditions of engineering activity, possesses basic knowledge on management, including quality management and running commercial enterprise, within the range of protection of intellectual property and patent law; knows general principles of creating and developing forms of individual entrepreneurship and basic HSE rules applicable to machine industry
Student can use basic literature and stores information about materials which are necessary in their specified applications.

Student can formulate main principles connected with the function/-s, design constraint/-s, objectives as well as free veriables ect. which are important in determining the material indexes used in materials selection.

syllabus_topics: Key issues related to design process
Methods of materials selection in practical applications by using limited line/-es, guideline/-es on Ashby's diagrams
Basic issues connected with materials selection taking into account the shape of elements
Fundamental issues related to manufacturing process in the context of materials selection

assessment_methods.method: Assessment of knowledge contained in written work and projects
Assessment of knowledge contained in presentation
Assessment of ability to analyse information
Assessment of ability to use knowledge gained from the subject

assessment_rules: The passing threshold for the subject is 50.0%. This represents 100.0% of the final grade.
bibliography: M.F. Ashby, H.R. Shercliff, D. Cebon: Materials: engineering, science, processing and design. 4th edition, Butterworth Heinemann, Oxford, 2019.
Mahmoud M. Farag: Materials and Process Selection for Engineering Design. 4th edition. Published December 30, 2020 by CRC Press.
M.F. Ashby: Materials Selection in Mechanical Design. 5th edition, Butterworth Heinemann, Oxford, 2016.
F.A.A. Crane, J.A. Charles: Selection and use of Engineering Materials. Butterworths. Boston, MA., 1984.
Kamaraj M.: Basics of Surface Technology, New Academic Science, 2018.
Kutz M. (Ed.): Handbook of Materials Selection. John Wiley & Sons Inc., New York 2002
degree: Mechanical Engineering, first-cycle (engineer), specialization Design and Production Engineering
